volume growth.

overall brand. As part of our commitment to further strengthen Almond Drops franchise, we 
launched the new enhanced positioning supported by our TV campaign based on hair strength 
leading to beauty.

and digital. This, for us, marks the start of reinvigoration and strengthening the premium position 
of this brand, and you shall see more action on this front in the coming quarters.

up 18% on H1 basis. We continue to maintain robust SOV/SOM ratios in traditional and digital

quarters. Spread across three phases, we covered GTM transformation across 13 key states.

S&D cost.

efficiency and attempt to improve throughput in these outlets in the balance of the year. But our 
work here is not over, as we will quickly move to Aarohan 2.0. In Aarohan 2.0, we will focus 
all our energies on expansion of our direct reach in urban by 10%, and in rural -- by more than 
that over the next six quarters.

have performed well across country clusters. This channel for the full H1 has grown ahead of 
the company growth, and except for Bangladesh, most of our other key markets individually 
have also grown ahead of the company average. Bangladesh is witnessing a tough operating 
environment and grew in the teens. 
 
Our international business is also improving a sharp improvement in profitability. And on the 
back of revenue scale-up, margin correction, and cost optimization, we are delivering a good 
improvement in the EBITDA margins of this channel.

On the overall margin front, this quarter witnessed continued volatility in key raw material prices 
due to the West Asia war, edible oil inflation, and the cascading impact of these two things. Our 
gross margins for the quarter were at 59.9%, and overall for the first half of the year at 60.8%. 
 
Despite the sequential reduction in gross margin, our teams have been able to rally around and 
deliver very strong savings in fixed costs and employee costs, which have allowed us to deliver 
a near-term high EBITDA margin of 25% and a PAT margin of 21%. 
 
Going forward, the cost environment remains volatile, and we stand committed to taking actions 
as appropriate to protect our P&L while being fair to our consumers. To remind everyone, as an 
organization, we had taken a calibrated price increase action towards the end of quarter 1. We 
will now follow it up with another round of price increase and ml-age reduction in quarter 3. 
 
In this round, we are approximately taking a 5% increase in consumer price, which will be split 
roughly equally between frontal price increase of 2% to 3% and a similar contribution coming 
through ml-age reductions. 
 
Overall, like always, we remain focused on strengthening our brands through enhanced 
advertising, digital investments, and by driving innovation. We will continue to work on building 
our growth portfolio and on expansion of our distribution footprint through Aarohan 2. All while 
staying prudent and committed to prudent financial management.
